decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the FAQ content with Small-Block-only prize language, removes all Big Block references, and reflects the revised primary-mint split.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already sets the Small Block primary-mint pool contribution to $5 and removes the obsolete independence relationship with the eliminated Big Block counter.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the About-page ticket and prize-draw copy with Small-Block-only language.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 prize-pool allocation and replaces the pool recipients with Small Block only.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already deletes the obsolete Big Block prize copy while retaining the valid Small Block copy.
Removing Big Block does not change the generic automatic wallet-transfer behavior, Winners-page announcement, or payment destination for surviving Small Block prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the metadata counter list with a Small Block ticket counter only.

The requirement's generic ticket, prize-notification, wallet-delivery, and dashboard-access behavior remains valid for the surviving Small Block mechanism and contains no current Big Block-specific state.

Badge triggers, milestone thresholds, and on-chain award destination are independent of the removed Big Block mechanism.
